t: Window scraper with retractable carbon steel head blade. Designed for removing paint from delicate surfaces such glass and tiles. The blade has three button positions: Top button position to enable blade replacement (do not use the scraper in this position), middle button position scraper is ready to use, bottom button position is to store the blade safely.
b: Removes Paint or Stickers From Windows or Glass
Dry Blade Before Storing to Avoid Rust
